messages:
maria-partnerships: Quick heads-up — OpenGrove (model provider) wants to co-launch a quantized 7B model + hardware SI bundle via Azure Marketplace and our SI partner EdgeLogic. Need cross-team kickoff: licensing, SKU packaging, sandbox cert, and joint announcement cadence. Can folks do a short kickoff Thu 10am PT? I'll drop pre-reads and sandbox creds.

alex-product: Sounds good. Proposed agenda: 1) licensing & redistribution check, 2) SKU manifest & pricing mapping, 3) staging/cert plan with EdgeLogic drivers, 4) announcement timing + embargo. Who owns release notes?

jamal-legal: We need to confirm redistribution rights and export controls. Ask OpenGrove for the submitted license, provenance of weights, and any third-party driver TOUs. I can draft redlines but need their draft by Wed EOD.

lin-eng: Sandbox/infra note: EdgeLogic requires driver v510+ and a specific kernel config for our private appliance images. For certing we need quantized container + driver bundle. Can OpenGrove provide a reference container image? If not, we'll host one but need TOU clarity. @deploy-bot can we reserve a staging slot Thu 12pm PT for a deploy smoke test?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled ephemeral cluster 'og-sku-test' for Thu 2024-10-26 12:00 PT (2024-10-26T19:00Z). Ticket #PRJ-8932.

sarah-marketing: Marketing asks: define GA vs limited preview messaging now. Recommend limited preview for marketplace listing + joint blog on GA. Need OpenGrove logo, short bio, and embargo window. Also any beta customer quotes? :thumbsup:

noah-sales: Sales input: Ensure SKU maps cleanly to Hosted, Dedicated, and Private offerings. We need a pricing matrix and guidance on enterprise entitlements for SI deployment (installation/service fees). I'll compile a draft and flag top accounts who should see the preview.

maria-partnerships: Linking checklist (internal stub): https://redwood/internal/partners/openGrove-onboard — includes doc checklist, manifest template, legal checklist, and staging access steps. I'll DM sandbox creds to @lin. @jamal-legal please confirm must-have redlines. EdgeLogic needs NDA for driver binaries.

jamal-legal: Adding required clauses: provenance attestation, redistribution license (explicit grant for marketplace), export compliance warranty, and indemnity carveouts around third-party drivers. I want to add a clause for source verification & signed attestation from provider. Will post redline draft Wed morning.

lin-eng: Perf targets to certify: p95 < 120ms on A100-80GB (batch=1, 512 tokens). Memory footprint < 20GB for int4 quantized runtime. OpenGrove: can you provide quantized weights + a model card with evals/platform comparators? If not, we can run our quantization pipeline but revenue split needs to be decided.

sarah-marketing: We'll need a 2-week embargo after marketplace approval so partner comms teams have time to coordinate. Also prepare a joint quote template for the announcement.

noah-sales: Also note: some enterprise customers will require on-prem private deployment; can EdgeLogic support on-prem installs or is this cloud-only? Need clarity for SKU descriptions.

lin-eng: Technical manifest (minimal) — sharing quick draft to iterate on:
```
model_name: open_grove-7b-q4
version: 2024-10-01
quant_type: int4
hw_requirements: [A100-80GB, H100-80GB]
container_image: ghcr.io/open-grove/redwood-runtime:v1.2
perf_p95_ms: 120
memory_gb_max: 20
provenance_url: https://open-grove.ai/provenance/open_grove-7b
license_url: https://open-grove.ai/license
```
Please add fields for pricing_sku_id and driver_bundle_sha.

jamal-legal: Add manifest requirements for provenance_url and license_url and a signed attestation field. Also require a checksum for any driver bundles and a signed TOU for binary-only drivers.

maria-partnerships: If vendor can't provide quantized weights, fallback option: we host quantization as a service and create a marketplace SKU with a revenue share. I'll circle back with finance if that route is needed.

sarah-marketing: I'll draft the announcement timeline and a one-pager for partners. Will share mock copy before the meeting.

alex-product: Who will own the marketplace listing flow? Product or Partnerships? We need someone to shepherd compliance with Azure Marketplace submission requirements.

maria-partnerships: Partnerships will shepherd the listing but need Product to sign off on the SKU manifest and eng to provide cert artifacts. I'll be PM for the listing.

lin-eng: Quick QA note: EdgeLogic's driver currently fails one kernel regression test on our private images — will need an RC build from EdgeLogic. Suggest we set an RC window next week.

noah-sales: I'll prepare a short customer notification plan and list of 10 priority accounts to inform under embargo.

maria-partnerships: Action items before Thu: OpenGrove -> weights + model card + container or manifest; EdgeLogic -> driver binary + kernel RC schedule; Jamal -> redline draft; Lin -> staging slot (done); Sarah -> embargo & draft announcements; Noah -> SKU mapping + account list. Meeting invite sent (https://meet.redwood/ocq-xyz). Thanks all.

maria-partnerships: Post-meeting: uploaded notes and action owner list to the checklist page. Follow-ups: Jamal to post redlines, OpenGrove to send attestation, EdgeLogic to confirm RC build ETA.
